text:
Maya Ortiz: Heads-up: legal pushed back on telemetry payloads for marketplace sellers — we need an opt-out flag for telemetry and a clear data residency note. We're also changing auth header format (v1 -> v2). Need partner plan.

Evan Brooks: Ack. Do we have to change marketplace billing contracts? Some sellers embed SDKs and rely on implicit header parsing.

Maya Ortiz: Not changing billing, but marketplace listings must include a migration note. We'll add a"Telemetry: optional" checkbox and a link to the migration guide.

Theo Martins: For the SDK change: add support for both headers during grace. Example: `Authorization: Redwood v2 <token>` or legacy `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. We'll deprecate legacy after rollout.

Nina Rao: For SIs with on-prem agents, we should publish an agent compatibility matrix. Some hardware partners run pinned agent versions and can't pick up new header behavior quickly.

Evan Brooks: Agreed. Proposal: 10-week runway from announce to enforcement. Weeks 0-2 docs + marketplace banner; Weeks 2-5 shim + private canaries; Weeks 6-8 broader canary; Week 10 enforcement.

Maya Ortiz: Partner comms: two paths — public marketplace banner + changelog, and a direct partner exec email for top 10 sellers/SI integrators. Who can own emails?

Theo Martins: I can own SDK shims and the migration README. Will open PRs for python/js/rust today.

Nina Rao: I'll build the compatibility matrix and list which partner SKUs are impacted. Also coordinating with eng-sre for feature-flag per partner.

partner-bot: New JIRA created PARTNER-9988 "Marketplace seller SDK auth/telemetry migration + opt-out" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PARTNER-9988

Evan Brooks: Need to flag partners that use embedded analytics — those require special schema mapping. I'll compile the list.

Maya Ortiz: Action items: Theo -> shims & SDK PRs; Nina -> matrix + flag gating; Evan -> partner analytics list; I'll draft the partner exec email and marketplace banner copy. We'll run office hours next Tue.

Theo Martins: Quick snippet for docs: ```http
POST /v1/telemetry
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Redwood v2 ABC123
X-RW-Telemetry-Version: 2
{"event":"inference","duration_ms":45}
```

Nina Rao: Note for legal: add explicit opt-out endpoint `POST /v1/telemetry/opt_out` so marketplace sellers can toggle at org level.

Maya Ortiz: Good call. Add opt-out to PARTNER-9988 checklist. Also recommend a short FAQ for marketplace docs: impact to billing (none), impact to analytics (possible mapping), rollback path (shim + flag).

Evan Brooks: I'll surface any partners that require on-site assistance. For two large SIs, we may schedule runbooks and a co-debug session.

Maya Ortiz: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after PRs land and before office hours. :thumbsup:
